name: IBM Generative AI Engineering Professional Certificate

entry.name: IBM Generative AI Engineering Professional Certificate
entry.note: A multi-course professional certificate, not a proctored exam; building applications with large language models
entry.audience: Developers and data scientists building applications on large language models

covers: machine learning, deep learning, and neural network principles
generative AI concepts, large language models, speech technologies, IBM watsonX, and Hugging Face
building generative AI applications and chatbots with LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, and Python frameworks
speech-to-text and text-to-speech integration for voice interfaces
web-based AI app development with Flask, Gradio, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
supervised and unsupervised learning, regression, classification, clustering, and dimensionality reduction
deep learning model building with Keras and performance interpretation
generative AI architectures and models such as RNNs, transformers, VAEs, GANs, and diffusion models
reading.format: Delivered online through Coursera with hands-on labs, projects, and a guided project.
reading.summary: This professional certificate from IBM covers generative AI engineering, including large language models, natural language processing, machine learning, and deep learning. Learners build and deploy generative AI applications, agents, and chatbots using Python libraries and frameworks such as PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, retrieval-augmented generation, and LangChain. The program includes hands-on labs and a guided project to create a real-world generative AI application. Finishing it indicates practical experience with prompt engineering, model training, fine-tuning, and NLP-based app development.
reading.audience: The page states it is for aspiring generative AI engineers, AI developers, data scientists, machine learning engineers, and AI research engineers. It is also intended for people aiming at roles such as generative AI engineer, AI research engineer, NLP engineer, machine learning engineer for generative models, deep learning engineer, and data scientist.
